description: Search live job vacancies on EURES (the EU's job mobility portal), or fetch full details for specific job vacancy IDs.

benefitCodes.description: Restrict results to jobs that explicitly advertise these extra (non-salary) benefits. Note: most EURES listings do not disclose extra-benefit information at all, so this filter narrows results significantly -- leave empty to include all jobs regardless of disclosed benefits.
benefitCodes.title: Extra benefits offered

countries.description: Restrict results to job locations in these countries. Leave empty for all EEA countries.
countries.title: Countries

educationLevels.description: Restrict results to these required education levels.
educationLevels.title: Education level

euresFlagOnly.description: Only return jobs explicitly flagged as cross-border EURES vacancies (employer welcomes candidates from other EEA countries).
euresFlagOnly.title: EURES-flagged jobs only

experienceLevels.description: Restrict results to these required-experience bands.
experienceLevels.title: Required experience

includeDetails.description: Also fetch each search result's detail record — salary, benefits, contacts, application link and full location. One extra request per emitted record; off by default for fast, low-cost searches.
includeDetails.title: Include full vacancy details

jobIds.description: EURES job vacancy IDs or full detail-page URLs, as found in the `jobId` or `sourceUrl` output field, e.g. `MzQwNDYwIDU` or `https://europa.eu/eures/portal/jv-se/jv-details/MzQwNDYwIDU`.
jobIds.title: Job vacancy IDs or URLs (mode=byIds)

languageSkills.description: Restrict results to jobs requiring at least basic proficiency in these languages.
languageSkills.title: Required language skills

minNumberOfPosts.description: Only return job vacancies offering at least this many open posts/positions (useful for finding bulk-hiring vacancies).
minNumberOfPosts.title: Minimum number of open posts

enumTitles: Lookup by vacancy ID or URL
mode.title: Mode

occupationUris.description: Restrict results to jobs classified under these ESCO occupation URIs or broader ISCO group URIs. Copy occupation values from the `occupationUris` field of a previous search result, e.g. `http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/f2b15a0e-e65a-438a-affb-29b9d50b77d1`; an ISCO URI such as `http://data.europa.eu/esco/isco/C2221` matches every occupation in that ISCO group.
occupationUris.title: ESCO occupation or ISCO URIs

positionOfferingCodes.description: Restrict results to these contract/position offering types.
positionOfferingCodes.title: Contract type

positionScheduleCodes.description: Restrict results to these work schedules.
positionScheduleCodes.title: Work schedule

publicationPeriod.description: EURES's own recency filter: only return vacancies received or last re-synced within this window (output field `lastModifiedDate`). This is not the original employer posting date (`publicationDate`) -- national employment services periodically re-sync unchanged listings, so an older vacancy can appear in a recent window.
publicationPeriod.title: EURES recency window

regionCodes.description: Restrict results to job locations in these region codes (finer-grained than `countries`), e.g. `deb` for Berlin (Germany) or `no0b` for Trondelag (Norway). Find a region's code in the `nutsRegionCodes` output field of a previous run, or on the EURES advanced-search location picker. Finer NUTS codes are automatically matched to the nearest supported parent region. Combines with `countries` as an OR (union of matches).
regionCodes.title: Region codes (NUTS)

searchIn.description: Where the search query is matched.
searchIn.title: Search scope

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword to search for (mode=search). Matches job title, description and employer name depending on `searchIn`.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sectors.description: Restrict results to these NACE Rev.2 business sectors.

enumTitles: Electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning supply
Wholesale and retail trade; repair of motor vehicles
Public administration and defence; social security
Human health and social work activities
Activities of extraterritorial organisations and bodies

sectors.title: Business sector (NACE)

skillUris.description: Restrict results to jobs requiring these ESCO skill URIs. Copy values from the `requiredSkills` field of a previous `mode=byIds` result, e.g. `http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/ccd0a1d9-afda-43d9-b901-96344886e14d`.
skillUris.title: ESCO skill URIs

sortBy.description: Order of returned results. `MOST_RECENT` orders by each listing's last-synced/last-modified timestamp in EURES's own index (output field `lastModifiedDate`), which usually but not always matches `publicationDate` -- national employment services periodically re-sync unchanged listings, which refreshes this timestamp without a new posting. Note: when `searchQuery` is set, results are always ordered by relevance (best match) regardless of this setting, since EURES cannot reliably combine keyword search with most-recent ordering.
sortBy.title: Sort by

title: EURES Job Vacancy Scraper Input
